findings.passage: May said to register, Indiana residents must be at least 18 years old on or before the upcoming election, have a valid Indiana Driver's License or Indiana State Identification Card, be a citizen of the United States, have lived in the same precinct for at least 30 days before the next election, and not currently imprisoned after being convicted of a crime.
findings.note: Caucus press release in his name restating the existing Indiana registration requirements, including a state ID and U.S. citizenship. It paraphrases him; it does not say whether he wants the rules changed.
